lead_raw_text:
The structure of CuAuTe₂ crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms—4 Cu, 4 Au, and 8 Te—distributed across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu and Au each coordinated by eight Te neighbors, while Te has ten geometric neighbors (4 Cu, 4 Au, 2 Te), with distances ranging from 2.6012 to 3.1986 Å. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner and face sharing between Cu- and Au-centered 8-vertex polyhedra and Te-centered 10-vertex polyhedra, plus corner sharing between Te-centered polyhedra.
